slides.texte_overlay:
things people with a
quiet mind do differently

they single task

they do one thing at a time and give it their full attention. a mind that isn't split between five tabs feels calmer, works better and remembers more.

they leave space in the day

they don't fill every minute with plans and noise. a few empty moments each day give their thoughts room to settle, like water slowly going clear and still.

they feed it gently

they give their mind something calm and interesting every day instead of endless noise: a constellation, a painting, a myth. a gently fed mind has far less room left for worry.
slides.texte_sophia:
they feed it gently

my mind used to feel crowded all day. now i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, a constellation or a painting, and that small calm habit quiets everything.

slides.texte_overlay:
they let thoughts pass

they notice a worry, name it and let it go by instead of chasing it. not every thought needs an answer, and most of them leave on their own if you let them.

they protect their mornings

they keep the first half hour of the day quiet, with no news and no messages. a calm start makes it far easier to stay calm when the day gets loud and busy.
